from solution import get_gcd
import solution


def test_issue_example_given():
    """Issue example: gcd of [2, 4, 6, 8, 16] is 2."""
    expected = 2  # gcd(2,4)=2, gcd(2,6)=2, gcd(2,8)=2, gcd(2,16)=2
    assert get_gcd([2, 4, 6, 8, 16]) == expected


def test_issue_two_elements():
    """Find the gcd of the given array elements with two inputs."""
    expected = 12  # 48=12*4, 180=12*15, gcd(48,180)=12
    assert get_gcd([48, 180]) == expected


def test_issue_single_element():
    """Find the gcd of a single-element array is the element itself."""
    expected = 7  # gcd(7)=7
    assert get_gcd([7]) == expected


def test_issue_coprime_returns_one():
    """Find the gcd of coprime array elements is 1."""
    expected = 1  # gcd(3,5)=1, gcd(1,7)=1
    assert get_gcd([3, 5, 7]) == expected


def test_issue_all_same():
    """Find the gcd of identical array elements is that value."""
    expected = 6  # gcd(6,6)=6, gcd(6,6)=6
    assert get_gcd([6, 6, 6]) == expected


def test_issue_order_independent():
    """Find the gcd of the given array elements regardless of order."""
    expected = 2  # gcd(16,8)=8, gcd(8,4)=4, gcd(4,6)=2, gcd(2,2)=2
    assert get_gcd([16, 8, 4, 6, 2]) == expected


def test_issue_odd_common_factor():
    """Find the gcd of [9, 15, 21] is 3."""
    expected = 3  # 9=3*3, 15=3*5, 21=3*7, common=3
    assert get_gcd([9, 15, 21]) == expected


def test_issue_three_multiples():
    """Find the gcd of [12, 18, 24] is 6."""
    expected = 6  # gcd(12,18)=6, gcd(6,24)=6
    assert get_gcd([12, 18, 24]) == expected


def test_contract_exposed_function():
    """Public interface exposes get_gcd(l) in solution."""
    assert callable(get_gcd)


def test_contract_returns_int():
    """Public interface get_gcd returns gcd as integer."""
    result = get_gcd([2, 4, 6])  # gcd(2,4)=2, gcd(2,6)=2 so literal 2
    assert isinstance(result, int)


def test_contract_deterministic():
    """Public interface get_gcd finds the same gcd on repeated calls."""
    assert get_gcd([12, 18, 24]) == get_gcd([12, 18, 24])
